overview_description.description:
Homzmart is an e-commerce platform that sells home furniture, home décor, lighting, and home supplies. The company specializes in the fields of home improvement, eCommerce, home directory, technology, and home shopping.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Cairo, Al Qahirah.

about_short_description.short_description: Homzmart is an online end-to-end platform that sells home furniture, home décor, lighting, and home supplies.

product.name: Home Furniture
product.description: Products including beds, sofas, dining sets, and storage units designed for residential use.

product.name: Home Décor
product.description: Decorative items like wall hangings, mirrors, vases, and rugs to enhance interior aesthetics.

product.name: Lighting
product.description: Various lighting fixtures such as ceiling lamps, table lamps, and wall lights for home illumination.

product.name: Home Supplies
product.description: Household essentials including kitchenware, bathroom accessories, textiles, and cleaning tools.

product.name: Home Appliances
product.description: Electrical appliances like air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, microwaves, and fans for domestic use.

product.name: Outdoor Furniture
product.description: Furniture sets and pieces designed for outdoor use, including materials resistant to weather conditions.
